worked_solution:
Let $u={x}^{2}+5.$ Then

$$
\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x}=2x\,⟹\,\frac{1}{2}\text{d}u=x\,\text{d}x,
$$

and we can solve the resulting integral as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}\int \frac{x}{{({x}^{2}+5)}^{10}}\,\text{d}x & =\int \frac{1}{{({x}^{2}+5)}^{10}}\cdot x\,\text{d}x \\  & =\int \frac{1}{{u}^{10}}\cdot \frac{1}{2}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{1}{2}\int \frac{1}{{u}^{10}}\,\text{d}u \\  & =\frac{1}{2}(-\frac{1}{9{u}^{9}})+C \\  & =-\frac{1}{18{u}^{9}}+C \\  & =-\frac{1}{18({x}^{2}+5)^{9}}+C\end{aligned}
$$
